pages.title: Bubble Merge: Word Sort
pages.creator: Kankane Games
pages.description: Bubble Merge: Word Sort challenges you to organize word bubbles by meaning. Drag and combine words belonging to the same category so they clear from the board. Use the available boosters when a group is difficult to identify and keep sorting the remaining vocabulary.

pages.title: Football Superstars 2026
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Football Superstars 2026 lets you choose from seven international teams for two modes of football. Play a friendly against your preferred opponent or enter the World Tournament. Guide the selected team through matches against international sides as you work toward the tournament title.

pages.title: Pool Duel
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Pool Duel gives you thirty seconds per shot in an eight-ball contest. Pocket your assigned solids or stripes before finishing with the eight ball. Alternate turns with the opponent and use prize money to unlock additional cues and table appearances.

pages.title: Prism Match 3D
pages.creator: AI Gate Labs
pages.description: Prism Match 3D asks you to remove a layered structure by collecting three identical tiles. Rotate and zoom to find uncovered pieces, then add them to the seven-slot tray. Complete matching sets before the tray fills so you can clear the entire board.

pages.title: Home Match: Tile Master
pages.creator: Gamee JSC
pages.description: Home Match: Tile Master challenges you to remove tiles in groups of three matching designs. Choose pieces that complete useful trios and continue until none remain. Work through the increasingly difficult arrangements to clear each level of the tile-matching puzzle.

pages.title: Shotting Balls
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Shotting Balls asks you to destroy every black block in a level with a controlled ball. Tap and drag to set its direction, then release to send it moving. Keep the ball on-screen to preserve lives and collect gems along the way.

pages.title: Jewel Dress Up
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Jewel Dress Up combines match-three puzzles with character styling. Clear jewels to earn coins, and win three puzzles to open three outfit choices. Use the money to buy more clothing and unlock additional characters as you build the wardrobe.

pages.title: How To Dress Your Dragon
pages.creator: Rising Pixel
pages.description: How To Dress Your Dragon lets you create a collection of customized dragons. Choose wings, outfits, accessories, headpieces, and stickers, then color individual body parts. Switch between the item and color tabs to finish a creature before viewing it alongside your other dragons.

pages.title: Helicopter Battle Steve 2 Player
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Helicopter Battle Steve 2 Player pits red and blue helicopters against one another. Control your aircraft, shoot the opponent, and keep your own helicopter from crashing. The first player to earn ten points wins the aerial contest between the two pilots.

pages.title: Girlfriend from Hell
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Girlfriend from Hell is a puzzle adventure about setting traps for an inconsiderate boyfriend. Search for useful objects and combine them into revenge setups around the environment. Work out where to use each item so the heroine's plan produces its intended result.

pages.title: Graffiti Tags: spray painting
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Graffiti Tags: spray painting lets you create wall art using different colors and surfaces. Paint your designs while keeping clear of the police pursuing you. Develop your street-art skills and work toward reaching new cities where more graffiti opportunities await.

pages.title: Academy Assault
pages.creator: Studio IFX
pages.description: Academy Assault follows Cael challenging the students of Imperium Academy before facing Rin. Win reaction-based standoffs by pressing Space faster than each opponent. Defeat the other academy members to earn the right to challenge its strongest fighter.

pages.title: 100 Rooms Escape
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: 100 Rooms Escape gives you a sequence of locked rooms with doors to open. Search for hidden objects, keep useful items in your inventory, and solve the surrounding puzzles. Combine discoveries with the correct interactions to continue through the hundred-door escape challenge.

pages.title: Draw To Smash!
pages.creator: Momo Games
pages.description: Draw To Smash! challenges you to eliminate bad eggs with shapes you create. Draw inside the white area, then release so the resulting object falls into the scene. Judge the size and shape of the drawing to crush every unwanted egg.

pages.title: Crazy Bubble Breaker
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Crazy Bubble Breaker asks you to remove bubbles using balls dropped from above. Hold to set a shot and release it toward the targets. Bounce balls off walls to reach additional bubbles and clear more of the arrangement with a single launch.

pages.title: Fruit Survivor
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Fruit Survivor puts a gardener under attack from fruit-shaped monsters. Move through the surrounding enemies and use different weapons to fight your way out. Choose upgrades for the equipment as you try to survive the growing attack on the cartoon garden.

pages.title: Sniper Shooter
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Sniper Shooter places you on a rooftop with a target to eliminate. Tap to line up the aim and release to fire, checking the remaining bullets before committing to a shot. Use the elevated position to make the limited ammunition count.

pages.title: Fairy Dress Up Games for Girls
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Fairy Dress Up Games for Girls lets you style fantasy pixies with dresses, shoes, wings, and accessories. Change their hair and combine the clothing pieces into a magical look. Include the fairies' pet companions as you complete the character's makeover.

pages.title: Boxes Wizard 2
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Boxes Wizard 2 gives a wizard teleportation and box-moving powers across forty puzzle stages. Push boxes to create routes or swap places with them to reach otherwise inaccessible spots. Use those abilities together to pass obstacles and complete each platforming layout.

pages.title: Red and Blue Stickman 2
pages.creator: Bin Studio
pages.description: Red and Blue Stickman 2 pairs Lavaboy with Ice Water girl in a temple full of cooperative puzzles. Activate buttons, move boxes, and collect diamonds before reaching the exits. Keep the red character away from water and the blue character away from fire.

pages.title: Shot For Hire
pages.creator: Melon Gaming
pages.description: Shot For Hire sends you along roads threatened by rogues attacking travelers. Recruit mercenaries from the guild and use accurate shooting to clear the challenges ahead. Unlock cities and expand the available connections while choosing companions to support the journey through Ravenburgh.

pages.title: Up Hill Racing
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Up Hill Racing lets you climb with vehicles ranging from bikes and trucks to an unusual rideable fridge. Collect coins and earn more through flips and airtime. Upgrade each vehicle to improve its handling and travel higher and farther along the hills.

pages.title: Cards 21
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Cards 21 gives you four columns for building card totals of twenty-one. Drag incoming cards onto a chosen platform and plan how their values combine. Manage the layout across the available three lives while working to create useful twenty-one-point stacks.

pages.title: Farm Hidden Objects
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Farm Hidden Objects asks you to locate items listed beside a farm picture. Examine the scene and select each object when you find it. Complete the whole search before the countdown expires to receive the bonus points for finishing in time.

pages.title: Overloaded Bus
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Overloaded Bus challenges you to manage passengers boarding and leaving a bus. Hold the input to let people move, then stop before the vehicle becomes too crowded. Keep the load within its limit, since an overloaded bus bursts and ends the attempt.

pages.title: Imposter Smasher
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Imposter Smasher asks you to defeat opponents before other characters notice your attack. Move into position, strike a target, and remain out of the surrounding rivals' view. Work through the encounters by choosing opportunities that let you remove enemies without being seen.

pages.title: Watermelon Run 3D
pages.creator: wey.game
pages.description: Watermelon Run 3D has you collect watermelon blocks while racing other characters. Carry the pieces to the water and use them to build shortcut bridges. Choose a route that helps you overtake rivals and complete tasks to unlock additional watermelon-themed outfits.

pages.title: Special Strike Operations
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Special Strike Operations casts you as a soldier holding off incoming enemy forces. Move, jump, crouch, and fire to survive each attacking wave. Complete waves to unlock stronger weapons and improve the equipment available for the next assault.

pages.title: Waggle Balls 3D
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Waggle Balls 3D asks you to tilt a table so the pieces roll into holes. Hold the mouse button and move to control the surface's angle. Guide every piece to a target while avoiding obstacles and completing the successive tabletop layouts.

pages.title: Hyper Life
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Hyper Life turns a life journey into a running track beginning with a baby. Move along the route and answer the important questions presented at each level. Your responses determine how the character's future develops as the simulated lifetime continues.

pages.title: Army Trucks Hidden Objects
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Army Trucks Hidden Objects hides ten bombs in each military-truck picture. Find and mark them within sixty seconds to complete the scene. Work through six levels by checking the vehicle and its surroundings for every concealed explosive before the countdown expires.

pages.title: Hyper Hockey
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Hyper Hockey adds changing goals and warp effects to an air-hockey contest. Move your striker to defend and send the puck toward the opposing net. Play locally with a friend or try Challenge mode, earning trophies from the matches you win.

pages.title: Arkadium's Sudoku
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Arkadium's Sudoku challenges you to complete a nine-by-nine number grid. Place digits one through nine so none repeat within any row, column, or three-by-three square. Select a number and an empty cell, using the supplied clues to determine each placement.

pages.title: Go to Fishing
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Go to Fishing challenges you to catch fish before the timer expires. Every successful catch adds seconds, giving you more opportunities to continue. Watch for piranhas that try to eat your fish and keep landing catches to extend the fishing session.

pages.title: GT Mega Ramp Car Stunts
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: GT Mega Ramp Car Stunts puts you in a car for driving challenges on towering ramps. Accelerate along the stunt routes and control the vehicle through the demanding course. Improve the supercar as you attempt the next set of high-ramp driving challenges.

pages.title: Infinite Bike Trials
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Infinite Bike Trials offers two hundred motorcycle stages in an obstacle-filled environment. Control the bike through each difficult course and reach its finish. Buy a different bike or change the rider's color as you continue tackling the remaining trial levels.

pages.title: Truck Soccer
pages.creator: crazyschoolgames
pages.description: Truck Soccer combines football with driving a monster truck. Steer the vehicle into position and use its movement to contest the ball, with a firing control available during play. Work toward scoring against the other side in the truck-powered match.

pages.title: Bunnies Driving Cars Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Bunnies Driving Cars Match 3 challenges you to clear rows of at least three matching pieces. Earn points from the combinations and keep the meter on the left from dropping too low. Continue making useful matches before the gauge empties and ends the game.

pages.title: Donut Challenge
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Donut Challenge pits you against another player in a race to grab pastries from a spinning tray. Reach for a donut's center and be the first to collect five. Watch the rotating plus and minus markers, since their values can change the round's outcome.

pages.title: Ninja Run Game with Double Jump
pages.creator: Pixellicious
pages.description: Ninja Run Game with Double Jump sends a ninja toward a distant destination through timed leaps. Tap once to jump and again while airborne to gain a second lift. Use the double jump to collect coins and continue safely toward the end marker.

pages.title: Fun Christmas Coloring
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Fun Christmas Coloring offers eight holiday illustrations and a palette of 23 shades. Choose a picture and color its sections, working quickly for a better finishing score. Save the completed Christmas image after applying the combination of colors you want.

pages.title: Offroad Real Stunts Bike Race : Bike Racing Game 3D
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Offroad Real Stunts Bike Race : Bike Racing Game 3D challenges you to ride a motorcycle along demanding stunt tracks. Handle the bike through difficult sections and attempt the maneuvers required by each level. Keep the vehicle controlled as the off-road courses introduce further stunting challenges.

pages.title: Flappy Color Ball
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Flappy Color Ball asks you to keep a ball airborne while passing through colored barriers. Tap to raise it and line up with sections matching the ball's current color. Control the height carefully so it crosses the correct part of each approaching obstacle.

pages.title: Santa T Rex Run
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Santa T Rex Run sends a small dinosaur across a grayscale desert. Time jumps to clear cacti, plants, and other obstacles as the background accelerates. Keep the T-Rex running without a collision to increase the score from the current attempt.

pages.title: Car Parking Simulator : Classic Car Park
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Car Parking Simulator : Classic Car Park presents a series of vehicle-positioning challenges. Drive through the different layouts and practice placing the car accurately in its parking location. Control the approach and steering as each stage asks for another careful parking maneuver.

pages.title: Offroad Racer
pages.creator: y9-games.com
pages.description: Offroad Racer puts you in a vehicle on a rough driving trail. Control the car's movement and balance as its wheels follow the uneven ground. Work through the terrain toward the route's end while keeping the off-road vehicle under control.

pages.title: Kawaii_Pumpkins
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description: Kawaii_Pumpkins asks you to build a stack by dropping pumpkins from a moving witch. Wait until she reaches a useful position, then release the next pumpkin onto the pile. Keep the expressive Halloween characters landing correctly to make the stack grow taller.

pages.title: Helix Knife Throw 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Helix Knife Throw 3D challenges you to break a wooden target by landing enough knives in it. Tap to launch each blade and avoid the knives already embedded in the wood. Clear the target to continue into the next throwing stage.

pages.title: Tropical Slasher
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Tropical Slasher has you cut fruit while keeping the knife attached to the trees at the sides. Slice as much as possible before time expires and avoid letting fruit escape. Stay clear of bombs, since hitting one ends the attempt immediately.

pages.title: Romantic Wedding Day
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Romantic Wedding Day lets you prepare Jane for her wedding by choosing her bridal appearance. Browse the dress-up options and combine the available pieces into a complete look. Help the excited bride finish the outfit she will wear on her special day.

pages.title: Triangle
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Triangle is a color-matching arcade game built around a three-colored shape. Change the triangle's orientation to align its section with the stick's color. Keep selecting the matching side as the next color approaches and the sequence continues.

pages.title: Monster Tower Defense
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Monster Tower Defense tasks you with stopping ball-shaped invaders before they reach your base. Place monster towers along the field and collect energy from destroyed attackers. Spend that energy on more defenders while progressing through eighteen levels that unlock additional monster types.

pages.title: Viking Wars 3
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Viking Wars 3 pits Vikings against each other on elevated platforms. Use the starting sword or collect an arrow weapon to knock the opponent off their footing. Score five knockdowns before your rival to win the platform-based combat match.

pages.title: Mandala Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Mandala Coloring gives you patterned drawings to decorate with a chosen palette. Select a mandala and apply colors to its different sections using the brush. Build a coordinated design or experiment with contrasting shades across the repeated shapes of the picture.

pages.title: Slalom Ski Simulator
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Slalom Ski Simulator challenges you to steer a skier around gates on a downhill course. Move left and right to follow the required route and reach the end. Return to each track to try for a faster time than your previous run.

pages.title: Birdy Drop
pages.creator: papio
pages.description: Birdy Drop asks you to guide falling birds into their matching nests. Tap a bird to change its falling speed and time its arrival at the correct landing place. Complete missions, earn unlocks, and try to increase the number brought down safely.

pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: 100 is a number-merging puzzle set in an alchemist's tower. Slide percentage-marked creatures together until they combine into cubes worth exactly one hundred percent. Completed cubes freeze in place, so plan later movements around them while finishing the rest of the board.

pages.title: Gladiators io
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Gladiators io puts you in an arena with other armed characters. Move your gladiator and strike opponents with the equipped weapon while trying to remain in the fight. Choose useful positions to engage rivals as the multiplayer-style combat continues around you.

pages.title: Missile Defense System
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Missile Defense System puts cities and villages under an incoming air attack. Aim your defenses at the missiles and destroy them before they strike the ground. Keep reacting to the waves of explosives to protect the settlements beneath the aerial assault.

pages.title: Great Fishing
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Great Fishing gives you three rods and a supply of worms for catching fish. Watch the lines and try to land both large and small catches. Dig up more bait after fishing and work toward completing the available achievements during the session.

pages.title: Witch to Princess Makeover
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Witch to Princess Makeover begins with cleaning a witch after mishaps on her broom. Remove leaves and dirt, then move into a spa treatment that transforms her appearance. Complete the makeover activities to turn the injured-looking witch into a refreshed princess.

pages.title: Solitaire master
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Solitaire master collects Solitaire, FreeCell, and Spiderette in one card-game selection. Choose a variant and work through its familiar card-stacking puzzle. Play for a stronger score or focus on completing the current deal before switching to another of the included games.

pages.title: Beer Rush Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Beer Rush Game challenges you to serve customers advancing along bar counters. Send drinks toward them and catch the empty glasses coming back. Lose a life if a customer reaches the bartender or a returned beer passes uncaught, so balance serving with retrieving.

pages.title: Bounce master physics game
pages.creator: Two Hands Lab
pages.description: Bounce master physics game challenges you to launch a ball and strike every shape in the level. Aim its path through the arrangement and use the bouncing movement to reach the targets. Remove the full set of shapes to unlock the next stage.

pages.title: Mermaid Ariel Christmas
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Mermaid Ariel Christmas combines dressing Ariel with decorating a festive tree. Choose the mermaid's hair and clothing, then arrange the available Christmas-tree details. Create a holiday look for Ariel and a matching seasonal display using the game's styling and decoration choices.

pages.title: Money Movers 3
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Money Movers 3 teams a prison guard with his dog to capture thieves. Switch between the two characters and use them together to handle the prison's obstacles. Bring both partners to the exit after working through the capture and escape-route puzzles.

pages.title: Princess Style Guide 2017 Military
pages.creator: MyCuteGames
pages.description: Princess Style Guide 2017 Military explores army-inspired fashion with Ariel and Moana as its models. Choose makeup and clothing from the military-style wardrobe to create their looks. Experiment with more than army green as you prepare both princesses for the style guide.

pages.title: Space Rescue
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Space Rescue asks you to collect stranded astronauts and return them to Earth. Tap to send the spaceship toward the next planet, avoiding traps along the route. Pick up fuel and watch the remaining supply while trying to rescue everyone for a three-star result.

pages.title: Mahjong Express
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Mahjong Express is a tile-pairing puzzle in which you remove matching designs from a layout. Choose available pairs and consider how each removal changes the next moves. Clear the full arrangement to finish the current mahjong board and try another challenge.

pages.title: Bomb It 7
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Bomb It 7 puts you in arenas where planted bombs eliminate opposing characters. Place explosives, move away from the blast, and use the openings they create against rivals. Try the different modes and work toward unlocking the game's achievements as you play.

pages.title: Rapunzel Sweet Vacation!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Rapunzel Sweet Vacation! helps Rapunzel prepare for her first pool day at a warm holiday destination. Choose makeup and clothing suited to her outing, then complete the accessories and styling. Finish the princess's vacation look before she heads to the pool.
